newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar closes firm in volatile trade.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar closes firm in volatile trade.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed firmer at 478.00/479.00 per dollar in volatile trade that saw strong Central Bank intervention, traders said.

It appears "that the Central Bank wants to increase volatility and it's achieved it," said one trader. "All this rising and falling, I haven't seen anything like it since exchange controls were removed," he added.
Traders said strong dollar demand saw the unit weaken to 481.50 in opening trade, but Central Bank dollar sales subsequently firmed the currency to its stronger close.
The bolivar closed Monday at 479.50/480.75 per dollar.
